title: Scheduled pg_dump lands an artefact and a fresh Postgres primed from it round-trips the row set
asA: operator responsible for restoring a Postgres project after a cluster loss or a data-integrity incident
iWant: a scheduled export runner that drives pg_dump against the live database and writes an artefact to the elicited destination
soThat: a fresh Postgres primed from the artefact returns the row set the source held at the artefact's completion timestamp

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a live Postgres containing a small fixture rowset, when the scheduled export runner runs, then it invokes pg_dump via child_process.execFile against the elicited connection URL, writes the artefact to the elicited destination, and emits backupExported with { artefactPath, completedAt }. A fresh Postgres primed by psql-restoring the artefact returns the same rowset (row count and row checksum both equal) as the source.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a live Postgres seeded with a fixture rowset and the recovery runner configured to write to a temporary destination
acceptanceCriteria.when: the recovery runner runs pg_dump against the source and a second Postgres is primed from the artefact
acceptanceCriteria.then: the runner exits 0, backupExported fires with the artefact path and completion timestamp, the artefact file exists at the elicited destination, and a query against the restored Postgres returns the same row count and same checksum of the fixture rowset as the source
